title: Codebook configuration guide
text: YAML file consists entries variable dataset. entry includes description, units, type, categories, labels, validation rules. breakdown component: description: brief explanation variable. units: units measurement (applicable). type: data type variable R (e.g., character, numeric). type_sql: data type variable SQL (e.g., VARCHAR(255), DECIMAL). categories: list possible categories categorical variables, separated semicolon without spaces (e.g., “M;F”). labels: Labels categories, specifying meaning category value. format use equals sign (=) associate value label, without spaces around equals sign. pair must separated semicolon (;). Example: “0=;1=Yes” “M=Male;F=Female”. validations: list validation rules ensure data quality. pointblank package used validation. validation rule defined key-value pair key name validation function (e.g., col_is_character, col_vals_not_null, col_vals_regex, col_vals_between) value list arguments function. primary_key (optional): Set true mark variable primary key table. one variable per codebook carry flag. foreign_key (optional): reference format <table>.<column> (e.g., study.study_id) indicates variable links column another table.

text: Project scaffolding: startProject(), addStudy(), addExperiment() addAnalysis() create structured FAIRground directory layout links clinical studies, laboratory experiments downstream analyses. Codebook-driven schemas: data tables defined YAML codebooks (codebookRead(), codebookToTable(), codebookToEntries(), codebookToSummary()), beFAIR creates maintains matching SQL tables. Database management: databaseInitialize(), databasePrepare*() family databaseUpdate() build refresh FAIRground database, including project overviews (databaseUpdateOverview()) linked publications (databaseUpdatePublications()). databaseExport() exports contents. Reproducible ETL: draftScript() generates ETL script templates codebooks (codebookToDraft()), sourceScript() runs tracks . plotDependencies() visualises dependencies scripts tables. Validation: validateDatabook(), validateSourceId() validateCytofExperiment() check data codebook rules loading, using pointblank. Harmonisation helpers: harmonizeDate(), harmonizeGates() getRelativeTimepoint() align dates, cytometry gates time points across studies. Participants get stable pseudonymised identifiers derived SHA-256. Data access: FAIRgroundConnect(), collectTable(), collectTablesById(), searchId(), tableSummary() tableVariableByStudy() query join harmonised tables.
